name: Wight General (Centurion Cameo)
resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks not made with silvered weapons
notes: The Roman commander who oversaw the initial binding of Mars's spear three centuries ago. Encountered in Session 1's Altar Chamber, and returns as a quiet cameo in Session 5 Scene 4 if spared.
gm_notes:
Session 5 Scene 4 Cameo (The Antechamber of Mars).

IF HE WAS SPARED IN SESSION 1 (party communicated with him or left him intact): His spectral form rises silently from one of the twelve outer plinths. He does not attack. If spoken to, he delivers one solemn line:

'I held this three hundred years so it would not have to end like this. I am glad I do not have to decide.'

The moment the spear's fate is settled (Option 1 Unmade, Option 2 Rome, or Option 3 Mars), his oath discharges and his spirit dissolves into golden ash. Do not run combat for him; this is a quiet narrative payoff.

IF DESTROYED IN S1: Do not place this token.
objective: Discharge his three-century oath of vault guardianship.
goal: Witness the final fate of Mars's Spear and find eternal rest.
agenda: Stand motionless upon Plinth 4; speak once if addressed by a surviving PC.
secret: He buried his own centurion seal under the granite anvil before accepting the guardian curse.
